breaks.break: returned loans are treated as open and get a reminder

given.why: B2's returned-loan case (loan2 is returned, then must not be sent) proves this. B1's own test only has open loans.

breaks.break: comparison inverted, so loans due after today are picked
boundary `<=`, so a loan due today is treated as overdue

given.why: B1 catches an inverted comparison. The due-today boundary is pinned only by B2's 'isn't overdue' loan (loan3, due 03-17, today 03-17).

breaks.break: today is taken in server local time instead of UTC
today is derived from a different format or offset

given.why: The clock is always 10:00Z, so local and UTC dates agree in nearly every time zone. No test sits near a UTC midnight.

given.part: it has no reminder recorded today

breaks.break: a reminder recorded on an earlier day wrongly blocks sending, so a loan is reminded only once ever
the filter is dropped, so a reminder already recorded today does not block

given.why: B2 pins 'already reminded today'. No test has a reminder from a previous day that must not block, which is the 'once a day' case.

then.part: Asks the Notifications API to notify the loan's member

breaks.break: never calls the API (dry run)
notifies with the wrong id, such as loanId as memberId
sends the wrong dueOn

then.why: The sent list is compared with exact memberId, loanId and dueOn for two different members, and its length is asserted.

then.part: then records a reminder for today

breaks.break: records nothing
records dueOn or another date instead of today
records the wrong loan id

then.why: The reminders table rows are asserted as exact loan_id and sent_on values (today 03-17, dueOn 03-16).

breaks.break: records before asking, so a refusal still leaves a record

then.why: This is B3's 'Records nothing for that loan'. mutants.json lists it under 'not mutated' for B1 for that reason.

given.part: An open loan already has a reminder recorded today

breaks.break: the already-reminded check is dropped, so the second run re-sends
the check matches only earlier days, as in the `sent_on < ?` mutant
the check matches a reminder on any day, so it ignores the date

given.why: The second run catches dropping the check, but no test has a reminder from another day, so a day-blind check passes.

breaks.break: returned loans are still picked up

given.why: loan2 is overdue and returned. The sent list must contain only loan1.

breaks.break: a loan due today is treated as overdue (`<=`)
overdue is not checked at all

given.why: loan3 is due exactly today (03-17), which pins the boundary.

breaks.break: sends to a skipped loan
sends nothing for any loan, so the eligible loan is also skipped
sends the reminder twice for the eligible loan

then.why: toMatchObject on a one-element array asserts exactly one send, for loan1, across two runs.

breaks.break: a refusal is treated as accepted

given.why: The fake refuses loan1 with a 503 reason, and the test checks that nothing is recorded for it.

breaks.break: an unreachable API makes the client throw and the job aborts
an unreachable API is treated as accepted

given.why: The fake only returns a refused result and never throws or simulates a connection failure. Nothing tests that an unreachable API reaches the job as a refusal, and B5 has no unreachable test either.

breaks.break: the failure path is only reached for some loans

given.why: The job runs over two overdue loans and one of them is refused.

breaks.break: records the reminder despite the refusal

then.why: The reminders table must equal only loan2's row.

nothing is logged

breaks.break: logged at info or error

then.why: The level is asserted as 'warn'.

breaks.break: logs the memberId, or omits the loanId

then.why: The fields are matched exactly with loan1's id.

breaks.break: a fixed string such as 'refused' instead of the reason

then.why: The error must equal the reason the fake returned.

then.part: carries on with the other loans

breaks.break: break or throw on the first refusal, so later loans are skipped
retries the refused loan within the run

then.why: loan2 is lent after loan1, so it must still be sent and recorded after loan1 is refused.

no log when there are no overdue loans

given.why: Only a run with three overdue loans is tested. A run with no overdue loans, which should still log zero counts, is not.

not logged, or not last

then.why: The last log entry must have this event name.

then.why: The level is asserted as 'info'.

then.why: The fields must equal exactly failed 1.

breaks.break: client sends with a wrong or missing reminder payload

given.why: A concrete reminder is passed to the real client, and the request body is asserted against it.

breaks.break: another method such as PUT

then.why: The method is asserted, and the handler is registered only for POST.

base URL ignored

then.why: The path is asserted exactly. The client is built from NOTIFY_URL and must reach the handler.

breaks.break: content-type is not application/json

then.why: The content-type header is asserted, and the body is parsed as JSON.

breaks.break: key renamed or value wrong

then.why: The body is asserted with toEqual.

then.why: The template value is asserted exactly.

breaks.break: key renamed or missing

then.why: The data object is asserted exactly.

breaks.break: key renamed or missing

then.why: The data object is asserted exactly.

breaks.break: only 200 accepted
only 200 and 202 accepted
2xx range cut short, with 201 or 206 refused

then.why: 200, 202 and 204 are tested. A narrower or enumerated acceptance that still contains those three would pass.

breaks.break: only 4xx refused, so 5xx is accepted
only 5xx refused, so 400 is accepted
3xx accepted

then.why: Only a 400 is tested, so 5xx and 3xx answers are never checked as refused.

a network error is treated as accepted

reason is empty or missing for a failed connection
